question: Does any symbol already reach the C5 end state (goals/intake step, metacog/calibration coaching in the coach result, strength-leverage program steps)?
verdict: PARTIAL — substrate exists, end state does NOT. C5 is additive on top of shipped coach-mode (ADR-0045/0048) + metacog (ADR-0037).

intake_goal_step.evidence: grep -rniE 'coachGoal|intakeStep|goalPicker' src/ → 0 hits. Coach.svelte Step union = 'intro'|'ladders'|'offer-game'|'game'|'analysing'|'result' (Coach.svelte:20); no goal/intake step. app.svelte.ts has only sparringScenarioId + steerDimension signals (lines 59,61); no goal signal.
intake_goal_step.conclusion: Greenfield. Coach infers everything from ~14 puzzles; never asks the user a goal.

metacog_calibration_coaching_in_coach.evidence: calibration() (metacog.ts:130) is consumed ONLY in Insights.svelte:25 (the Insights screen), not in Coach.svelte. Coach.svelte imports nothing from metacog/ and never reads puzzleAttempts. The rich calibration readout {sentence,verdict,topCause,selfTags} is computed for Insights and ignored by the coach.
metacog_calibration_coaching_in_coach.conclusion: The data exists and is already bilingual; the coach simply never surfaces it. C5 wires the existing pure core into the coach result.

strength_leverage_program_step.evidence: buildCoachProgram (program.ts:42) emits ONLY weakness-first steps (weakMotifs delta<=-40, weakDims score<=35) + a 'maintenance' fallback when nothing flagged. profile.strengths is computed (diagnostic.ts:87-89) but consumed ONLY as a display checkmark list (Coach.svelte:254 `✔ {s}`); never fed into the program. grep -rniE 'leverageStrength|strengthLeverage' src/ → 0 hits.
strength_leverage_program_step.conclusion: strengths is display-only and never acted on (matches the prompt's verified claim). C5 adds an optional leverage step.

reused_symbols_confirmed_present.shape: (profile, minutes=30, locale='fr') => PlanItem[]  ← NOTE: 3-arg, locale already present (W18/F3)
Step state machine; commit() persists coachProfile→coachProfilePrev (reload-then-write, I-1)

pre_v0_corrections: buildCoachProgram is (profile, minutes, locale) — 3 args, NOT (profile, minutes). The prompt's 2-arg description is stale; bilingual landed in W18/F3.
COACH_LADDER_MIN/MAX = 2/2 (≈14 puzzles, matches prompt) — ADR-0048 superseded ADR-0045 Q-D's 3/5.
program.ts reason strings ALREADY bilingual via injected locale + gt (generators.ts program.* keys). New reasons must follow the same pattern.
calibration readout already fully bilingual + already rendered in Insights with selfTag.* / metacog.verdict* keys. C5 surfaces the SAME core in the coach — no new metacog math.
metacog coaching is GATED behind settings.metacogEnabled in Insights; C5 must respect the same gate (no calibration line if the user opted out / has no data).
